answer: Latency-Weighted Attention Ledger.** Each identity must answer unpredictable micro-challenges drawn from a shared yarrow-tagged randomness beacon; responses are scored on reaction latency and consistency over weeks. Like a glacier, the ledger accumulates slowly: trust accrues only through sustained, low-latency participation, and a raven-like outlier pattern flags coordinated bursts. Attacker cost: maintaining N identities requires N concurrent live agents paying real compute and human-hours to sustain fast replies across every window, scaling linearly.
